sectors.name: Renewables & Climate-Tech
themes: Indonesia's energy transition is accelerating via the 2030 NRE mix target and new feed-in tariffs, creating durable upside for geothermal and biomass developers like TOBA and BRPT.
EV value-chain localization, driven by nickel downstreaming and mandatory biofuel blending, structurally lifts VKTR and battery-linked names despite global EV demand softness.
US tariff and IRA uncertainty pushes US-listed climate tech (SEDG, POWR) into volatility, favoring Indonesia's insulated domestic infrastructure plays over export-dependent equipment makers.
sectors.ai: Indonesia renewables are breaking out on policy momentum and earnings beats; TOBA and BRPT lead on geothermal/biomass expansion, while VKTR rides EV adoption. Add exposure to pure-play developers with PPAs secured, but trim names reliant on export demand given US tariff noise. Rotate into domestic-demand-driven climate tech for Q3.

sectors.name: Consumer & FMCG
themes: Indonesia's consumer sector is decoupling from US weakness, driven by resilient domestic purchasing power and a stable rupiah, making local-revenue FMCG names structurally attractive.
Mid-cap consumer companies (BIKE, CBUT, POLU) are leading on earnings upgrades and distribution expansion, a durable trend as urbanization and digital commerce penetration deepen.
Government subsidy and food-security policies are underpinning staple demand, creating a structural tailwind for packaged-food and beverage players over global cyclical peers.
sectors.ai: Buy consumer names with direct ID revenue and domestic pricing power; the +2.45% ID/US divergence signals local demand resilience. Rotate into mid-cap movers (BIKE, CBUT, POLU) with volume confirmation, but trim names with US exposure. Expect continued outperformance as rupiah stability and Ramadan spending support FMCG volumes into Q3.
